exempt.PousTargets: open targets: every pinned statement as a sorry stub
exempt.CheckAxioms: the headline #print axioms list (`lake env lean CheckAxioms.lean`)
exempt.Grader: the grader executable, which imports only Lean
exempt.submissions: graded one file at a time by grade.sh

Pous.Assumptions.why: a named assumption reads the protocol's definitions, never a guarantee or a proof

Pous.Assumptions.P2.why: P2's pins and its cost model read only the game, the models and the parameters

Pous.Guarantees.why: a guarantee is stated over the protocol's definitions with named assumptions as hypotheses, never over a proof

Pous.Guarantees.P2.why: P2's pins and its cost model read only the game, the models and the parameters

Pous.Protocol.why: the protocol's definitions are trusted text: they import no assumption, guarantee or proof

Pous.Protocol.Model.why: the models import the game and each other, not the parameters or a proof

Pous.Protocol.P2.why: P2's pins and its cost model read only the game, the models and the parameters
